crs.publicSummary:
Updates to this application were made as a result of ICANN approving an application change request submitted by the applicant. Updates were made to the following application question response(s): 
 • Updated public questions: AGB Q118.
 • Updated confidential questions: AGB Q.176.1, AGB Q.176.2, AGB Q.176.3, AGB Q.176.4, AGB Q177.1, AGB Q177.2, and AGB Q178.

questionsChanged.questionText: AGB Q118. What is the meaning/definition of the applied-for gTLD string?
questionsChanged.finalResponse: In Chinese Pinyin system, "mai" embodies both buying and selling, making it a natural symbol of commerce and trade.
